additional_info.subject: RE: ID0367593-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P3 170000422] Connector1 constantly in Preparing status CRM:00579000944
additional_info.body:
Hi Oliver,
Greetings of the day!
Kindly provide us with the following information:
Whether this issue persist with a particular vehicle or multiple vehicles?
If it is for particular EV, please share with us the Model number of the same.
Since when is this issue occurring?
Have you checked rebooting the charger ?
As per the timestamp provided by you, we have checked the logs and found that-
The connector was stucked in "Preparing" because the session was interrupted by the vehicle. Refer the logs below:
Sun, 07 Jul 2024 10:01:22 GMT
2024-07-07, 10:01:21
2024-07-07T10:01:21.520019+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] ecog-secc-adapter/7e575c998130[702]: {"type":"session_stop","timestamp":1720346481021,"chargerId":"secc2300-01498","
outlet":"1",
"outletType":"CCS","payload":{"unexpected":true,"error":{"code":67,"msg":"ERR_EV_DROPPED,
vehicle ended with unexpected pilot state B
"},"
source":"EV
","start":1720344430682,"duration":1976,"energy":27470,"user":"internal","EVCCID":"e00ee1010070","EVMAC":"e0.0e.e1.01.00.70"}}
Sun, 07 Jul 2024 12:08:11 GMT
2024-07-07, 12:08:11
2024-07-07T12:08:11.062591+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] ecog-secc-adapter/7e575c998130[702]: {"type":"alert","timestamp":1720354090048,"chargerId":"secc2300-01498","
outlet":"1",
"outletType":"CCS","payload":{"src":"stack","code":54,"msg":"ERR_EVCOM,
EV communication problem detected"
}}
But there were also some charging sessions where the status of connector 1 was changed from "Preparing" to "Charging" as well.
Sun, 07 Jul 2024 09:28:26 GMT
2024-07-07, 09:28:26

Charging
"}
Kindly provide us with requested information to proceed further.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
